definitions.explanation: A low, inarticulate sound expressing pain, suffering, or distress.

examples.japanese: {呻|うめ}き{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}え→耐える：12087_taeru⟧きれず{呻|うめ}き{声|ごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: The patient couldn't bear the pain and let out a groan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{呻|うめ}き{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧きて、⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すくんだ→すくむ：10356_sukumu⟧。
examples.english: A faint groaning came from the back of the dark room, and I froze involuntarily.

notes:
A compound of {呻|うめ}き (groaning; the noun form of ⟦{呻|うめ}く→呻く：15021_umeku⟧, to groan) and {声|ごえ} (voice; sound). Describes involuntary vocal sounds produced due to physical pain, illness, or extreme discomfort. Commonly appears in medical contexts, literature, and horror or suspense narratives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {呻|うめ}き{声|ごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to let out a groan
- {呻|うめ}き{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: a groaning voice can be heard
- {苦|くる}しそうな{呻|うめ}き{声|ごえ}: a pained groan
- ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧{呻|うめ}き{声|ごえ}: a low moan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲鳴|ひめい}→悲鳴：12621_himei⟧: scream; shriek — louder and more sudden than a groan
- ⟦{嘆|なげ}き→嘆く：11814_nageku⟧{声|ごえ}: lamenting voice — expresses grief or sorrow rather than physical pain
- ⟦{唸|うな}り{声|ごえ}→唸り声：15092_unarigoe⟧: growl; snarl — a threatening or fierce sound, often from animals
